b1_invalid_dependency.preflight_evidence: The exact atomic FAILURE binds the prior external plan hash and records a training-stage breadcrumb after tokenizer/model preflight, exact immutable inputs, and protected e33 preservation.

material_violation.interruption: FFN update 3 after STATIC 4 and FFN 2 completed updates

heldout.bank_rule: split=eval; families=d0,d1,d2; variants=4,5; instances=2; offset=34100; seed=20261113; order=instance,variant,family
heldout.freshness_claim: fresh exact task keys excluded from e33 and B1 weight-training data
heldout.prior_exposure_disclosure: variants 4/5 were previously evaluated at instance offset 33100

training.optimizer_lifecycle: construct only after baseline, destroy state and object before next arm
training.update_rule: zero_grad(set_to_none=True); 12 sequential row backwards of loss/12; verify e33 no gradients after every row and update; one finite global preclip norm; clip once; step once
training.internal_gradient_gate: FFN internal and each recurrent transition/memory/workspace group must each have at least one finite nonzero gradient observation across updates 2..4
training.output_scale_gate: FFN and recurrent output_scale must be finite and nonzero after update 1
training.precision: bfloat16 modules and frozen e33; float32 loss/gradient summaries
training.checkpoint_selection: final update only; no early stopping or heldout selection
training.evaluation_timing: one shared baseline before optimizer construction; each arm final evaluation immediately after its step 4 and optimizer destruction
training.restart_rule: Restart STATIC, FFN, and RECURRENT from the exact seed and construction order; do not load or reuse any partial invalid-run module or optimizer state.

evaluation.metric: BR5-aligned heldout target NLL plus exact correct-path token-trie action margin from the same forward

action_margin.counterfactuals: change only final select_cognitive_action function.arguments.action among the three frozen actions
action_margin.trie: unique non-prefix leaves over assistant-target suffix token IDs in frozen action order
action_margin.branch_value: correct-token logit minus maximum other live-child-token logit at every branching node along the correct teacher-forced leaf

nomination_gates.1_execution: exact 4x12 updates for every arm, exact order/exposure/hparams, 12/12 heldout pre/post, finite, no e33 grad or update
nomination_gates.2_recurrent_learning: mean L_REC4>=.001; median>=0; strict wins>=7/12; every action mean>=-.005; worst>=-.05; mean M_REC4>=0; worst>=-.50
nomination_gates.3_matched_noninferiority: mean A_N>=-.0025; median>=-.005; every action mean>=-.010; worst>=-.050; mean A_M>=-.050; every action mean>=-.10; worst>=-.50
nomination_gates.4_positive_recurrence: NLL route: mean A_N>=.001, median>=0, wins>=7/12, at least 2/3 action means>=0; OR action route: mean A_M>=.020, median>=0, wins>=7/12, at least 2/3 action means>=0
nomination_gates.5_depth: R1_NLL-R4_NLL mean>=-.0025 and worst>=-.05; R4_margin-R1_margin mean>=-.05 and worst>=-.50; plus NLL mean>=.0005 OR margin mean>=.010
nomination_gates.6_retention: for every row and R1/R2/R4/R8 flattened visible slot state versus encoded task anchor: cosine>=.995, norm ratio in [.95,1.05], relative L2<=.10
nomination_gates.7_stability: all eight memory RMS changes>1e-6; every row median memory contraction steps2..8<=.90 and max<=1.25; every row memory oscillation<=.25 and aggregate mean<=.10; finite
nomination_gates.8_R8_nonregression: R8_NLL-R4_NLL mean<=.005 and worst<=.05; R8_margin-R4_margin mean>=-.10 and worst>=-.50

evaluation.nomination_rule: gates 1-3 and 5-8 plus either route in gate 4; otherwise valid b1_not_nominated

saved_state: FFN.final.pt: codec and one-shot sidecar only
RECURRENT.final.pt: codec and recurrent sidecar only
outputs.candidate_artifact_validity: Compact candidate files are scientifically valid only when their hashes are bound by the exact atomic SUCCESS.json terminal receipt. A caught post-write fault publishes FAILURE.json with hashes of every present candidate and marks them invalid_unclassified_do_not_use. If infrastructure loss prevents either exclusive terminal receipt, every candidate file in the namespace is invalid_unclassified_do_not_use and MUST NOT be evaluated, nominated, resumed, or published.
outputs.terminal_sequencing: All evaluation, protected-state audits, and immutable-input rehashes precede candidate writes. Candidate writes are exclusive and atomic per file; terminal SUCCESS/FAILURE publication is exclusive and atomic. This contract does not claim multi-file transactional atomicity and therefore makes the terminal receipt, not filename presence, the validity authority.

boundaries.promotion_statement: B1 cannot promote. Any later promotion requires at least four complete, error-free live harness trajectories on four distinct fresh task keys under the unchanged contract.

resources.gpu: one NVIDIA RTX A6000 48GB used sequentially; second GPU remains idle
resources.allocator_fraction_rule: Immediately after torch.cuda.set_device(0), before model load or the first caching allocation, set_per_process_memory_fraction(cuda_memory_cap_bytes / total_device_bytes, 0), record requested and observed fractions, and reset peak stats.
resources.memory_checkpoint_rule: At 404 exact ordered checkpoints, record current and maximum allocated and reserved bytes and abort ResourceContractExceeded if any exceeds 34359738368: after model load, all 60 captures, module construction, every evaluation forward and evaluation completion, every training-row backward, every clip and step, every optimizer destruction and arm completion, final audits, before and after each of three candidate writes, and immediately before SUCCESS.
resources.memory_failure_rule: Any memory-cap violation or allocator OOM is infrastructure_invalid, publishes atomic FAILURE with the full memory block, and leaves every candidate invalid. No scientific threshold, row, sequence, arm, optimizer, or numerical mechanism may change in this repair.
